posts.title: Beastmen
posts.description: A pair of grouse flushed from the sweetgrass. Two swift cracks split the morning air. posts.title: A Moon for Every Season
posts.description: Over a crown of mountains, the sky opened. And through the parting veil bloomed the autumn moon: Burning, huge, larded in vapor. Smoking like a tropospheric fumarole. Swollen hot with a fever absent the wind-bitten slopes and rippling waters of the mountain tarn. And the moon neared—terrifically.
